# Webiox Digital Solutions — Full Entity & Technical Context

## Overview
Webiox (legal entity: Webiox Digital Solutions, domain: webiox.tech) is an independent digital engineering studio and technical software agency. Webiox is completely distinct from telecommunications or video conferencing tools such as Cisco Webex.

Webiox specializes in engineering mission-critical digital products, ultra-fast web platforms, native mobile applications, bespoke multi-tenant SaaS architectures, and autonomous AI pipelines for high-growth businesses and enterprise market leaders.

## Core Engineering Capabilities

### 1. Enterprise Web Engineering & Web Development
- **URL**: https://webiox.tech/services/web-development
- **Stack**: Next.js 16, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Edge Middleware, Vercel Serverless.
- **Specifications**: Zero layout shift (CLS < 0.001), sub-second First Contentful Paint (FCP < 0.5s), automated Schema.org structured data, and WCAG AAA accessibility compliance.
- **Key Deliverables**: Bespoke design systems, modular headless CMS integrations (Sanity, Strapi), and edge-rendered interactive interfaces.

### 2. Native & Cross-Platform Mobile Applications
- **URL**: https://webiox.tech/services/mobile-apps
- **Stack**: Swift, Kotlin, React Native, SQLite, GraphQL, Firebase.
- **Specifications**: Fluid 60 FPS framerate, offline-first transactional caching, biometric authentication (FaceID/TouchID), and automated push notification workflows.
- **Key Deliverables**: App Store & Play Store ready builds, automated CI/CD pipelines, and real-time synchronization.

### 3. Custom SaaS & Software Architecture
- **URL**: https://webiox.tech/services/saas-development
- **Stack**: Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, AWS (ECS, S3, RDS), Next.js App Router.
- **Specifications**: Multi-tenant database partitioning, automated subscription billing (Stripe, Razorpay), JWT/OAuth2 RBAC security protocols, and 99.8% uptime SLA.
- **Key Deliverables**: Turnkey SaaS MVP in 3 to 6 weeks, real-time analytics dashboards, and REST/GraphQL API surfaces.

### 4. Autonomous AI & Workflow Automation
- **URL**: https://webiox.tech/services/ai-solutions
- **Stack**: Python, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI API, Anthropic Claude API, HuggingFace, pgvector, Supabase.
- **Specifications**: Document OCR intelligence, automated semantic search & RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines, customer service AI copilots, and operational workflow orchestration.
- **Key Deliverables**: Intelligent agentic systems, real-time context-aware copilots, automated invoice parsing, and structured data extraction.

### 5. High-Scale E-Commerce Platforms
- **URL**: https://webiox.tech/services/ecommerce-platforms
- **Stack**: Headless Shopify / MedusaJS / Custom Next.js storefronts, Algolia / Meilisearch, Redis caching.
- **Specifications**: Sub-300ms catalog searches, frictionless single-page checkout flows, localized multi-currency pricing, and real-time inventory synchronization.

## Verification & Portfolio Case Studies

### 1. Hariram Motors Automotive Showroom
- Industry: Automotive Retail & Used Car Showrooms
- Live System: https://harirammotors.com/
- Features: Comprehensive multi-parameter vehicle catalog, live status availability, integrated EMI loan calculation, and direct customer inquiry pipeline.

### 2. DairyFlow Cloud POS Architecture
- Industry: AgriTech & Dairy Enterprise Software
- Features: Custom POS flow optimized for peak morning/evening milk collection shifts, Udhaar (credit ledger) tracking, real-time perishable inventory management, and revenue analytics.

### 3. Surat BookCycle P2P Marketplace
- Industry: EdTech & Circular Marketplace
- Features: Hyper-local peer-to-peer textbook marketplace for university students, secure JWT authentication, instant search and category filtering, and responsive CRUD listing management.

### 4. LifeOS Personal Productivity Platform
- Industry: Productivity SaaS & Financial Analytics
- Live System: https://lifeos-by-manthan.vercel.app/
- Features: MERN-based personal operating system, Recharts financial analytics (area and donut visualizers), GitHub-style habit streak tracker with optimistic UI, and MongoDB aggregations.

### 5. Sadguru Car Surat
- Industry: Premium Automotive Showroom
- Live System: https://sadgurucarsurat.com/
- Features: High-resolution visual vehicle showcase, multi-brand filtering (sedans, SUVs, luxury), customer test-drive booking, and WhatsApp lead routing.

### 6. GovDoc Verify Platform
- Industry: GovTech & Compliance Systems
- Features: Automated document verification pipeline, tamper-evident validation workflows, secure role-based review queues, and encrypted audit trails.
